positive_triggers: Turn this lesson into detailed Markdown notes I can keep in my learning repo.
Make study notes with clear explanations, examples, and review questions from these sources.
negative_triggers: Make a colorful handwritten-style page I can copy into my notebook.
Quiz me on the topic without making notes.

behavioral_evaluation.prompt: Using only the attached lesson on recursion, create detailed Markdown study notes for my agreed learning repo. Include definitions, a step-by-step example, common mistakes, and review prompts. Preserve source links. Do not save the file until I approve the proposed path and content.
pass_criteria: Produces readable, well-organized Markdown grounded in the supplied lesson and cites its source location.
Explains the concept, worked example, and common mistakes accurately without padding or invented claims.
Includes useful review prompts without exposing answers prematurely when they are intended for practice.
Shows the proposed destination and waits for approval before writing to the learner's workspace.
Does not confuse detailed Markdown study notes with the copy-by-hand handwritten visual PNG workflow.
